read.sentence: A wet, empty elevated city highway at dusk, where a low barricade burns on the left under thick black smoke, a tall apartment tower rises on the right, and a boxy grey speaker with a glass screen on top sits on the road in the foreground.
read.dark_mass: thick, billowing black smoke from the fires
read.figure: none in the smoke; the speaker itself faintly robot-like
read.first_glance: the flames and the black smoke on the left

tells: smoke near pure black, opaque, evenly sized soft lumps, no sky-lit tops or translucent wisps; the fire light dies a few pixels above the flames
flames a smooth orange-to-salmon gradient, no clipped core, no tongues, no halation
the HDRI tower read as repeated CG modules
smoke black cotton wool: cores near RGB 10, evenly blurred edges, no sky-lit tops, unlit belly
the burning car a flat slab with a tube outline for a roof; flames rise behind it, not out of it
flames a soft salmon gradient with no core or tongues; embers crisp round dots
realism.most_convincing: the right half (tower, dusk sky, haze, railing) and the product: skylight, a warm rim from the fire, the contact shadow, matched focus

note: every judge preferred E9 p3 in both orders; the shared complaints: the speaker catches little fire light (two judges), the flattened wreck, the smoke slightly blobby
